Name: Leah's Art Gallery
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
Leah opens an art gallery, and you can buy her work.  Items based off art show, 10-heart event, movies and festivals. 

Her gallery is in the museum.  Go up the stairs. It shows up after seeing her 8-heart event, art show or online art selling. There is an override feature if you want the gallery sooner or you skipped her events.

There is an outside entrance which is a must if you use SVE. 

Items for sale:
All 3 paintings of Marnie based of the 10-heart event.
Movie based signs
Easter basket and eggs
Christmas presents
Creepy hands
Soup Pot
Plus more, see the pictures
Plus [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33552]NPC Portraits_Pictures[/url] are for sale. (If you have that mod installed.) 

I hope you enjoy this mod and look at my others including [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29766]Emily sells clothing at the Oasis[/url]. The blue Santa hat comes from that mod.
